Macro of the week

The facts that move money this week, with their source. The → BTC line is context, not a recommendation.
1. US CPI rose 0.4% in October (seasonally adjusted); core CPI rose 0.3%. BLS published no year-on-year figure for October.
→ BTC: Sticky prices plus a likely Fed hike in December are a short-term headwind for BTC.
U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics · 10 November 2026
2. The Bank of England raised Bank Rate by 25 bp to 4.00%.
→ BTC: Another big central bank tightening: money gets dearer for risk assets, BTC included.
Bank of England · 5 November 2026
3. The ECB plans a 12-month digital-euro pilot from the second half of 2027 with 36 payment providers.
→ BTC: A new payment rail for the same euro: it changes how you pay, not who sets the money.
European Central Bank · 5 November 2026
